# ChordChart

**Class:** `UltraCanvasChordChart` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasChordChart.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasChordChart.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasChordChart.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Flows between categories arranged on a circle

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasChordChart> CreateChordChart( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasChordChart> CreateChordChartFromMatrix( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h, const std::vector<std::vector<double>>& matrix, const std::vector<std::string>& categoryNames, const std::vector<Color>& colors =;   // Convenience: builds a chart straight from a square matrix.
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasChordChart(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

|---|---|---|
| `SetValueFormatter()` | `void SetValueFormatter(std::function<std::string(double)> f)` | Takes a callback. |

| `onFlowClick` | `std::function<void(size_t from, size_t to, double value)> onFlowClick` | _Flow click_ |
| `onCategoryHover` | `std::function<void(size_t categoryIndex)> onCategoryHover` | _Category hover_ |
| `customCategoryTooltip` | `std::function<std::string(const ChordCategory&)> customCategoryTooltip` | _Custom category tooltip_ |

### struct `ChordMatrix`

Square matrix of directed flows. `flows[i][j]` is the amount moving from category i to category j. A category's arc is sized by its throughput (row sum + column sum), so categories that only receive still get an arc.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `flows` | `std::vector<std::vector<double>> flows` |  |
| `categories` | `std::vector<ChordCategory> categories` |  |

Methods: `AddCategory`, `SetFlow`, `GetFlow`, `Size`, `Clear`, `ResizeMatrix`, `RecalculateTotals`, `GrandTotal`

### enum `ChordRibbonColorMode`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Source` | Ribbon takes the source category's colour |
| `Target` | Ribbon takes the target category's colour |
| `Larger` | Colour of whichever endpoint has the larger throughput |
| `Blend` | 50/50 blend of both endpoints |

### enum `ChordLabelPlacement`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoLabels` | No labels |
| `Outside` | Horizontal text just beyond the ring |
| `Radial` | Text runs along the radius, flipped on the left half |
